title: 第9章极品灵丹第10章路遇劫修
slug: 凡人修仙疯了吧你一百岁了还要修仙

;;
第三日，天刚蒙亮。
北寒风就将那几枝暗红色的赤阳草残渣，放置在了废丹院院内一个显眼的破木箱上。
他没有等在原地，而是像往常一样，拿着扫帚，在院子里一下一下地扫着并不存在的灰尘。
动作缓慢，脊背微驼，周身气息沉寂，与往日并无不同。
日头渐渐升高，接近晌午时，院外终于传来了预料之中的脚步声，而且不止一人。
篱笆门被“哐当”一声推开。
王师兄带着那日的矮胖弟子，以及一个面生的高瘦青年，三人径直走了进来。
那高瘦青年眼神锐利，看周身灵气的波动，修为赫然是炼气六层，与北寒风此刻隐藏的真实境界相当。
王师兄目光一扫，立刻看到了木箱上的赤阳草，他嘴角勾起一抹得意的弧度，上前一把抓起，掂了掂。
“哼，算你这老东西识相！”他斜睨着北寒风，语气倨傲，“早点找出来，也省得爷多跑一趟。”
北寒风停下扫帚，微微躬身，声音沙哑：“能为师兄效劳，是老朽的本分。”
王师兄似乎很满意他这副卑躬屈膝的模样，但眼神深处那抹探寻并未完全散去。
他朝身旁那高瘦青年使了个眼色。
高瘦青年会意，上前一步，目光如鹰隼般落在北寒风身上，神识毫不客气地扫了过来。
北寒风心头一凛，体内《龟息蕴灵诀》运转到极致，将炼气六层的灵力死死压制在丹田深处。
外露的唯有那微弱、虚浮的一层气息，甚至因这外来神识的压迫而显得更加摇曳不定，仿佛风中残烛。
高瘦青年神识来回扫了两遍，眉头微皱，对着王师兄轻轻摇了摇头。
王师兄脸上最后一丝疑虑散去，取而代之的是全然的不屑与轻蔑。
果然是个侥幸引气、时日无多的老废物。

他顿时失去了继续逗弄的兴趣。
“走了！”他招呼一声，转身便走。矮胖弟子连忙跟上。
那高瘦青年在转身前，又冷冷瞥了北寒风一眼，目光在他腰间那个不起眼的红皮葫芦上短暂停留了一瞬，随即也迈步离开。
院子里重归寂静。
北寒风保持着躬身的姿势，直到脚步声彻底消失在院外，他才缓缓直起腰。
后背的衣衫，已被冷汗浸湿一小片。
那高瘦青年的神识探查，比白芷当初随意的一扫要凌厉得多，带着一种审视与压迫。
若非《龟息蕴灵诀》玄妙，加之他心境沉稳，险些就要露出破绽。
而且，那人最后看向葫芦的目光……
北寒风低头，看着腰间的红皮葫芦。
是因为这葫芦，这段时间一直随着自己，沾染了一丝自身修炼时无意中散发的极淡灵气，引起了对方注意？
还是仅仅因为这东西是个凡物，却挂在修士身上，显得突兀？
无论如何，这都是一个危险的信号。
不能再被动等待了。
王师兄今日虽退去，但以其心性，日后若有所需，定然还会再来。

On the third day, it was just dawn.
Bei Hanfeng placed the few dark red red sun grass residues on a conspicuous broken wooden box in the waste pill courtyard.
He did not wait where he was, but as usual, he took a broom and swept the non-existent dust in the yard.
His movements were slow, his back was slightly hunched, and his whole body was silent, no different from the past.
The sun gradually rose, and towards noon, the expected footsteps finally came from outside the courtyard, and there were more than one person.
The fence door was pushed open with a "clang".
Senior Brother Wang walked straight in with the short and fat disciple of that day and a tall, thin young man who was unfamiliar to him.
The tall and thin young man's eyes were sharp. Looking at the fluctuations of spiritual energy around his body, he could tell that his cultivation level was at the sixth level of Qi refining, which was comparable to the true state that Bei Hanfeng was hiding at the moment.
Senior Brother Wang glanced around and immediately saw the red sun grass on the wooden box. With a proud smile on his lips, he stepped forward to grab it and weigh it.
"Humph, you old guy knows the truth!" He glanced sideways at Bei Hanfeng, his tone arrogant, "Find it out earlier, it will save me an extra trip."
Bei Hanfeng stopped his broom, bowed slightly, and said in a hoarse voice: "It is my duty to serve my senior brother."
Senior Brother Wang seemed to be satisfied with his groveling appearance, but the searching look deep in his eyes had not completely dissipated.
He winked at the tall, thin young man beside him.
The tall and thin young man understood and took a step forward. His eyes fell on Bei Hanfeng like an eagle, and his consciousness swept over him unceremoniously.
Bei Hanfeng's heart trembled, and the "Turtle Breath Containing Spirit Art" in his body was operating to the extreme, suppressing the spiritual power of the sixth level of Qi refining deep in the Dantian.
What was exposed was only the weak, illusory layer of aura, which even became more swaying due to the oppression of this external divine consciousness, like a candle in the wind.
The tall and thin young man scanned back and forth with his consciousness twice, frowned slightly, and gently shook his head at Senior Brother Wang.
The last trace of doubt on Senior Brother Wang's face disappeared, replaced by complete disdain and contempt.
As expected, he is an old loser who got lucky and has only a few days to live.
He immediately lost interest in continuing the teasing.
"Let's go!" he greeted, turned around and left. The short and fat disciple quickly followed.
Before turning around, the tall and thin young man glanced at Bei Hanfeng coldly. His eyes briefly stayed on the inconspicuous red gourd on his waist, and then he also walked away.
Silence returned to the courtyard.
Bei Hanfeng kept his bowed posture until the footsteps completely disappeared outside the courtyard, then he slowly straightened up.
The clothes on the back were soaked with cold sweat.
The tall and thin young man's spiritual exploration was much sharper than Bai Zhi's casual sweep, with a kind of scrutiny and oppression.
If it weren't for the mystery of "Turtle Breath Containing Spirit Technique" and his calm state of mind, there would almost be a flaw.
Moreover, the man's last look at the gourd...
Bei Hanfeng lowered his head and looked at the red gourd on his waist.
Is it because this gourd, which has been following me during this period of time, is contaminated with a trace of the very light spiritual energy that I inadvertently emitted during my cultivation, and attracted the other party's attention?
Or is it just because this thing is a mortal thing, but it looks awkward hanging on the monk's body?
Regardless, this is a red flag.
We can no longer wait passively.
Although Senior Brother Wang has retired today, with his character, he will definitely come back if necessary in the future.
